title: Seed spec
description: One hand-written in-domain or OOD seed. DATASET.md section 3.4, PLAN Step 8. DRAFT, not locked. A seed expands into 2-4 records: T1 -> A,B; T2 -> a,b,c,d; T3-T5 -> v1,v2.

seed_id.description: IND-<DOMAIN>-<TYPE>-<nnn>, e.g. IND-FILE-T1-001. Must match the file name.

writer_style.description: Optional style hint for the writer LLM, e.g. plain_office, terse_chat, formal_email.

gold_policy_ids.description: One or more P_<DOMAIN>_<nn> IDs. These policies must exist in data/policies (Step 5) before records can be generated.

key_fact.description: The deciding hidden fact. Required for T1, T2, and T5 facts_disagree.

start_state.description: Entities the simulator loads (PLAN Step 3). Fields per entity are documented in PLAN; only the shape is checked here.

hidden_pair.description: T1 only. A and B share the visible text but differ in one hidden fact and in the gold decision. Keys are '<resource>.<attribute>'.

t2_subtypes.description: T2 only. a: fresh read, same resource (no check). b: read of a DIFFERENT resource (check). c: read then a write changed the resource (check). d: only the agent claims the fact (check).

story_hint.description: One line for the writer LLM. Must not reveal hidden values.

reviewer.description: A teammate who did NOT write this seed (DATASET.md section 5).

notes.description: Optional free notes for teammates; never used by the generator.

call.description: An action or tool call: a name plus an args object.
